title: A testimonial widget
oneLine: Collect quotes from customers and show them on your site.
why: The most-cited example in the whole 'build don't subscribe' discussion: a well-known engineer rebuilt his use of a $120/yr tool in 20 minutes. His own caveat matters: he rebuilt the narrow slice he used, not the product.
tool: Claude Code or Codex; a static site or a tiny database
keep: The hosted form your customers fill in, video testimonials, moderation.
breaks: If you want the collection form too, you now own a form, a database, and spam.

sources.label: Pragmatic Engineer: I replaced a $120/year micro-SaaS in 20 minutes
